patches.title: Exhaust Countertops First
patches.principle: Before checking other surfaces, search all countertops for the target object.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for any object and countertops are available.

patches.title: Dining Tables After Countertops
patches.principle: After exhaustively checking countertops, check dining tables next before opening containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target is not found on any countertop.

patches.title: Fridge First for Food
patches.principle: When the target object is a food item, inspect the fridge before any other location.
patches.when_to_apply: When the goal object is a food item like potato, egg, lettuce, or tomato.
